text_blocks.snippet: To enter Lithuania, most foreign nationals need a visa, unless they are from a visa-exempt country or eligible for a visa-free stay under the Schengen Agreement. Schengen visas allow for stays of up to 90 days within a 180-day period in the Schengen Area, which includes Lithuania. For longer stays or specific purposes like work or study, a national visa (type D) is required.
snippet_highlighted_words: most foreign nationals need a visa, unless they are from a visa-exempt country or eligible for a visa-free stay under the Schengen Agreement

list.snippet: Schengen Visa: For short stays (up to 90 days) in Lithuania or other Schengen countries.
National Visa (type D): For longer stays (over 90 days) or for specific purposes like work, study, or family reunification.
